info.title: hibiki-asr
info.summary: Local Whisper speech recognition with a cancellable job API.
info.description: Submit audio, poll the job, cancel it if needed. Models are installed and versioned through the `/v1/models` endpoints; `/v1/diagnostics` explains which device is used and why.

get.summary: Is the engine up? (no token needed)
Hardware, the device in use, and findings that explain a CPU fallback

schema.title: Response List Models V1 Models Get

get.summary: Can Hugging Face be reached directly, and which mirror is best?

post.summary: Test extra endpoints, e.g. a mirror the user typed in

schema.title: Response List Downloads V1 Models Downloads Get

delete.summary: Cancel a download (idempotent; partial data is kept for resuming)

post.summary: Download a model version together with the components it needs

put.summary: Choose which installed version jobs use by default

post.summary: Submit audio for transcription (multipart: `params` JSON + `audio` file)

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: Variant installed by `hibiki-asr setup`, if known.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Download from this Hugging Face compatible endpoint first, e.g. https://hf-mirror.com.

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: Keep trying the configured endpoints and mirrors when `endpoint` fails. False downloads from `endpoint` only.

DownloadRequest.title: DownloadRequest
DownloadRequest.description: Optional per-download overrides. Everything left out uses the engine settings.

source.title: Source
source.description: Endpoint the data is currently coming from.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable machine readable identifier, e.g. CT2_NO_GPU_SUPPORT.

hint.title: Hint
hint.description: What to do about it. Commands are copy-pasteable.

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description: One observation about the environment, with a fix the user can act on.

env.title: Env
env.description: GPU related environment variables that are set.

HardwareProbe.title: HardwareProbe
HardwareProbe.description: What the machine has. Collected with the standard library only.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable identifier, e.g. MODEL_LOAD_FAILED, WORKER_CRASHED, AUDIO_DECODE_FAILED.

speech_ms.title: Speech Ms
speech_ms.description: How much of it was speech, according to the VAD.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: queued | loading | decoding | vad | transcribing | done

queue_position.title: Queue Position
queue_position.description: 1 = next to run. Null once it started.

output_languages.title: Output Languages
output_languages.description: Languages of the produced text, e.g. ['zh'] for a translate model.

requires.title: Requires
requires.description: Shared components downloaded with the model.

update_available.title: Update Available
update_available.description: A newer version than the installed ones exists in the catalog.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Pinned Hugging Face commit the files are downloaded from.

active.title: Active
active.description: This is the version used when a job names the model without a version.

size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
size_bytes.description: Download size of the model's own files.

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.description: Extra endpoints to test on top of the configured ones.

RuntimeFacts.title: RuntimeFacts
RuntimeFacts.description: What the installed inference stack can do. Collected in a subprocess so a broken install cannot crash the API.

device.title: Device
device.description: What actually ran the model ('cuda' also means ROCm/HIP).

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: A GPU was expected but the CPU was used. See findings for why.

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: A GPU was expected (requested, or present under 'auto') but the CPU is used.

Selection.title: Selection
Selection.description: The device and precision the engine will use, and whether that is a step down from what was wanted.

reachable.title: Reachable
reachable.description: A small pinned file was fetched and its sha256 matched the catalog.

huggingface_reachable.title: Huggingface Reachable
huggingface_reachable.description: The official https://huggingface.co can be reached directly.

recommended_endpoint.title: Recommended Endpoint
recommended_endpoint.description: The fastest source that works, or null when none does.

default_endpoint.title: Default Endpoint
default_endpoint.description: What downloads use first when a request names no endpoint.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: One line per damaged or missing file.

api_version.title: Api Version
api_version.description: Bumped only for breaking API changes. Clients require a minimum.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Optional features this engine offers. Clients gate features on these.
